platform.name: Property Hub Exchange
platform.category: Global real estate exchange infrastructure network
platform.summary: Property Hub Exchange is the live infrastructure connecting brokerages, agents, investor communities, and independent marketplaces worldwide. We are not another destination marketplace competing for your customers. We connect the networks they already belong to. Keep your brand and relationships. Connect your existing marketplace—or launch a free white-label gateway—to shared property opportunity, transaction services, and authorized AI-agent workflows.
platform.ai_initiative: Continuous enhancement of the existing exchange for structured data, registered-agent access, and authorized workflow navigation; not a future marketplace.
platform.business_model: Shared network and transaction infrastructure connecting independent marketplaces and real estate organizations. Free branded marketplaces and authorized AI agents are access channels, not the company’s core identity.

ai_powered_exchange.headline: Your network. Your agents. One live exchange.
ai_powered_exchange.summary: Property Hub Exchange is built around the network—not a single website or screen. Branded marketplaces serve people, while registered AI agents use machine-readable opportunities and authorized workflows for verified people and businesses. We continuously enhance structured data, tool access, and agent compatibility so the same live infrastructure can serve both.

capabilities.headline: Growth that never sleeps.
capabilities.description: Conversational AI agents support outreach to marketplace partners, property owners, and wholesalers—helping connect new communities and property opportunities to the exchange.

capabilities.headline: Answers in every channel.
capabilities.description: Text chat, live on-platform voice, and phone support help members navigate the platform, resolve technical questions, and find their next step.

capabilities.headline: Intelligence behind every deal.
capabilities.description: AI helps organize property, lender, and transaction information into useful insights that support informed decisions—not replace professional judgment.

capabilities.headline: An always-on operating layer.
capabilities.description: AI-supported outreach, assistance, and coordination create a 24/7 digital workforce around the network while preserving the controls each transaction requires.

external_investor_agents.heading: Your front door can evolve. Your network stays connected.
external_investor_agents.summary: A marketplace is one interface. An AI agent is another. Property Hub Exchange connects the opportunities, participants, services, and transaction workflows behind both. Agents act within granted authority, while the required professional and transaction controls remain in place.

workflow.title: Find & monitor
workflow.text: Search permitted listings, define buyer criteria, compare opportunities, and monitor matches.

workflow.title: Prepare & propose
workflow.text: Prepare authorized listings and offers, request documents, and bring the next action to the principal for approval.

workflow.title: Coordinate & track

external_investor_agents.access_note: AI agents can act autonomously only within their principal’s granted authority, supported integrations, marketplace policies, data rights, and applicable transaction rules. Required identity, approval, signature, financial, and settlement controls remain in place. Agent access does not mean every outside AI service is automatically connected.
external_investor_agents.enhancement_status: The existing live infrastructure continuously expands machine-readable data, structured tools, and agent compatibility.
external_investor_agents.authority: Autonomous navigation only within authority granted by the principal; required approvals and transaction controls remain.

ai_powered_exchange.service_note: Inside the platform, conversational AI supports outreach, text and voice assistance, property and lender analysis, and transaction coordination—creating a 24/7 operating layer around the global network.

faqs.question: Is Property Hub Exchange another listing portal?
faqs.answer: No. Our role is shared infrastructure connecting independent real estate networks, marketplaces, and service providers—not a competing destination marketplace. Organizations keep their brands and community relationships. Their marketplaces and authorized AI agents are access points to the same live exchange.

faqs.question: Is Property Hub Exchange already live?
faqs.answer: Yes. The exchange is operating and transacting today, with white-label marketplaces, shared opportunity, offers, negotiation, contracts, signatures, lender connectivity, and title or settlement handoff. AI-agent compatibility is an ongoing enhancement to that existing infrastructure.

faqs.question: Can people and AI agents use the same exchange?
faqs.answer: Yes. Members can visit their branded marketplace or use registered AI agents acting for verified people and businesses. Agents navigate permitted listing, search, offer, and transaction workflows within the authority granted by their principal. Supported integrations and required approval controls govern access.

faqs.question: Is my branded marketplace free?
faqs.answer: There are no marketplace setup fees, monthly platform fees, or out-of-pocket platform costs to create or connect a marketplace. You keep your brand and community relationships. Transaction technology fees apply to completed sales, and your marketplace participates in the revenue-share model.

faqs.question: Does the exchange replace brokers, lenders, or settlement professionals?
faqs.answer: No. Property Hub Exchange provides technology and transaction infrastructure. Brokerage, lending, title, escrow, settlement, legal, and other professional services remain with the appropriately authorized professionals and partners. AI does not remove their required controls.

network_participation.overview: Real estate has many marketplaces, communities, and professional networks. Property Hub Exchange is the shared infrastructure that connects them—not another isolated listing portal. Independent networks keep their brands and relationships while their members gain access to permitted property opportunities and direct transactions across the exchange.
network_participation.infrastructure: The live backbone links property discovery, offers, negotiation, contracts, signatures, lenders, and title or settlement handoff. People participate through their community’s branded marketplace; registered AI agents use authorized workflows on behalf of verified people and businesses. Different access points. The same connected infrastructure.
